title: Market Raja MBBS
desc: While in the pursuit of Raja, a ruthless don, the police accidentally kill Chandrababu, a medical student. Things take a turn when Chandrababu's spirit possesses Raja and turns him into a gentle soul.

title: Sardaar Gabbar Singh
desc: The kingdom of Rathanpur is forced to face the wrath of Bhairav Singh, who unceremoniously usurps their land. They later find respite when Gabbar Singh, a brave policeman, takes on their oppressor.

title: Kasam Paida Karne Wale Ki
desc: Aarti's husband gets killed by his paternal uncle in order to usurp his wealth and estate. She swears on her unborn child to avenge his death.

title: Antim: The Final Truth
desc: Rahul runs away from his poverty-stricken village life to become a gangster in the city. There, he locks horns with an upstanding policeman who tries to set him on the right path.

title: Valimai
desc: When a city's crime rate rises, it is up to Arjun, a police officer, to restore order.

title: Wanted
desc: A sharpshooter is caught between a gangster who wants him dead since he knows too much, the police who want him for the information he holds and his girlfriend who yearns for him to mend his ways.

title: Rudhramadevi
desc: Fearing that his people will not accept a female successor, a king raises his daughter, Rudrama Devi, like a boy. Years later, when a threat looms over the kingdom, she sets out to fight her foes.

title: The Great Robbery
desc: A shaman believes that sacrificing a woman's head can bring him supernatural powers and joins hands with a smuggler to steal a deity's crown.

title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Khatarnak Ishq
desc: Arumugam, a kind-hearted and honest man, finds himself involved in a fight against corrupt politicians after he protests against the pollution of water in his village.
